cast.name: Lynleit
cast.role: Fionn's biological daughter and displaced heir
cast.goal: Reclaim MSF from Helena, protect the people in her care, and investigate the Spill. During her later absence, she also keeps her son outside the conflict.
conflicts: Helena's accusation
She must recover allies inside the agency now hunting her.
Forbidden witnesses
Mikhail knows she disclosed magic to Kyrien, Felix, and Reiner. She insists on handling the breach herself.

cast.name: Kyrien
cast.role: Independent operator and later MSF director
cast.goal: Survive Lynleit's control, master the intelligence side of MSF, pursue the Prosecutor General responsible for his family's destruction without abandoning his mother, and eventually make choices inside the hidden world on terms that are genuinely his own.
conflicts: Concealed recruit
Felix distrusts him, and his position initially depends on Lynleit's protection.
Command without a Magiarch
He later runs MSF's ordinary and supernatural work while Lynleit is absent.

cast.name: Felix
cast.role: MSF officer, friend, and personal bodyguard
cast.goal: Protect Lynleit without allowing either protocol or her intuition to place an untrustworthy person beyond scrutiny.
conflicts: Lynleit's judgment
His distrust of Kyrien brings him into conflict with the friend he wants to protect.
Attachment to Lynleit
His hopes remain centered on Lynleit while familiarity and affection grow with Sherie. Reciprocating Sherie's teasing is easier than recognizing how important she has become to him.

cast.name: Reiner

cast.goal: Protect Lynleit while testing whether disciplined loyalty can accommodate the anti-protocol risk she has chosen.
conflicts: Trust and protocol
Supporting Lynleit's secret recruitment means accepting a breach he would ordinarily oppose.

cast.name: Fionn
cast.goal: Protect Narvea from a magical conflict whose participants can manufacture ordinary political reality as cover.
conflicts: Delayed action
Competing pressures keep him from acting as Magiarch in time.
Succession
Naming an heir would endanger that person; leaving the question open divides MSF after his death.

cast.name: Sherie
cast.role: Diplomat in training and covert negotiator
cast.goal: Become a diplomat capable of turning Drake's strategic understanding into alliances, while tracing the suspected coup without exposing MSF cooperation.
conflicts: Unauthorized agreement
Her private approach to MSF would be stopped if the Court or government discovered it.
The cost of persuasion
She enjoys making attraction useful and can keep playing while consequences grow beyond what she understands. Reading a response well does not tell her what the other person will do afterward.
Uneven attachment
Felix becomes increasingly important to her while remaining fixated on Lynleit. Sherie has limits to what attention she will accept; she wants to be seen clearly, not simply enjoyed as a diversion.

cast.name: Drake
cast.goal: Locate the coup network, prepare Sherie for state diplomacy, and justify the Duke's trust without allowing friendship to become cover for his mistakes.
conflicts: Official limits
He needs MSF's help but objects to Sherie's unauthorized agreement and will not surrender sensitive evidence.

cast.name: Father Mikhail
cast.goal: Complete the Cardiff assignment, contain supernatural threats under Church authority, and prevent necessary secrecy from becoming moral surrender.
conflicts: Lynleit's methods
They protect one another in Cardiff without agreeing about how the work should be done.

cast.name: Helena
cast.goal: Hold MSF long enough to make her version of events irreversible.
conflicts: An incomplete inheritance
Her formal control of MSF does not give her Fionn's private protocols or his officers' confidence.

cast.name: Natalia
cast.role: Independent magical examiner and private investigator
cast.goal: Fund and protect an independent life of magical research while giving clients an answer before hidden authorities reduce their problem to jurisdiction, secrecy, or punishment.
conflicts: Institutional interference
The Academy, Magiarchy, and Church can restrict her inquiries or claim her cases.

cast.name: Heyk
cast.role: Ducal Guard field agent and bodyguard
cast.goal: Serve Drake and Sherie while learning what massacred his squad and making his survival answer for something.
conflicts: The lost squad
He cannot explain the forces that killed his unit.

scenes.title: The Last Man out of the Park

cast.name: Hiyu
cast.goal: Prove that the impossible explanation fits the disappearances, then learn enough restraint to keep the discovery from destroying both investigators.
conflicts: Confidence before evidence
His excitement over an explanation can commit him and Yulia to danger he has not assessed.

cast.name: Myka
cast.goal: Become useful without mistaking raw ability for readiness, while learning which parts of Natalia's independence are worth following and which carry risks the Academy was built to contain.
conflicts: Danger at the Academy
She needs outside help to survive inside the institution training her.

cast.name: Yulia
cast.goal: Keep Hiyu alive, test his impossible theory honestly, and preserve enough reliable evidence to understand what ordinary criminology cannot explain.
conflicts: Unfamiliar evidence
Her training offers no established procedure for what happens in the park.

cast.name: Ash
cast.role: Grey cat of the Director's House
cast.goal: Remain in the Vilen house as shelter and territory.
conflicts: An unwanted guest
Lynleit tries to put him out before deciding to let him stay.

cast.name: Inspector Leo
cast.goal: Account for every missing person, regardless of who classified the reason.
conflicts: Withheld evidence
The quarantine blocks access to the people and places his investigation concerns.

cast.name: Lester
cast.goal: Help Natalia when ordinary methods fail while preserving the autonomy and secrecy of a life the hidden authorities may refuse to recognize.
conflicts: Classification
Institutions may treat his demiholumn nature as a threat rather than accept him as a person.

cast.name: Tien
cast.goal: Protect Helena and remove her enemies without exposing either the assignment or the relationship.
conflicts: Opposing asset
Kyrien interferes with his work for Helena.

facts.title: Walking on water, in secret
facts.text: Lynleit keeps the talent secret from everyone because the Church strongly punishes miracle-making that imitates acts associated with Jesus, saints, saviours, and other sacred figures, even when the effect seems harmless. She practices alone at night on secluded stretches of local lakes and rivers.

facts.title: Kyrien's whiskey flask
facts.text: Kyrien reserves a small drink for exceptional danger, exhaustion, distress, or a difficult personal moment. He sometimes calls it medicine. Lynleit learns its usual pocket.

facts.title: A mystery she wears
facts.text: Yulia received the necklace as a birthday gift but does not know who sent it. She considers the unknown giver a "crime mystery", although no crime has occurred. She wants to find out, has no way to do so, and wears it anyway.

facts.title: An uninvited resident
facts.text: Ash enters uninvited, repeatedly slips away when Lynleit tries to catch him, and stays once she lets him shelter from the rain.

facts.title: She follows him anyway
facts.text: Yulia is reliable, meticulous, and most comfortable with evidence she can test against an established procedure. Hiyu's eureka moments give her a headache. She follows him anyway, checking his leaps and having to consider possibilities her usual methods would exclude.

facts.title: Off duty, with Felix
facts.text: With Felix she can be theatrical, petty, ridiculous, or openly delighted without losing his respect.

facts.title: Sherie
facts.text: "When men and women play games, the prize is either cathartic or catastrophic. That is nature's whim."

facts.title: Sherie
facts.text: "Schrödinger's butt: she may want to get to know you closer, or kick your head in. With Lynleit, you won't know until you do."

questions.title: Core mystery
questions.text: Which incompatible agendas intend which outcomes around Fionn, and how do they accidentally cooperate to cause a death that none completely controls?

questions.title: Park trespass
questions.text: How do Hiyu and Yulia bypass the cordon, what happens to them inside, and what evidence survives their experience?

questions.title: Hotel refuge
questions.text: What does Kyrien witness when Lynleit breaks down at the hotel, and what changes between them by morning?

questions.title: Kyrien
questions.text: What is the Prosecutor General's name and own magical status, who authorized and carried out his father's killing, and what exact physical sequence makes the dinner attempt fail without revealing magic to Kyrien?

questions.title: Prosecutor General
questions.text: What later abuse, prohibition, proof, and jurisdiction make punishment possible? Ordinary political involvement is not enough. When does Lynleit offer revenge, and does punishment actually occur?

questions.title: Kyrien's obligations
questions.text: How does his mother's continuing care work across later assignments, and what durable cover protects his paid service from Fionn and Helena? The neighbour and written terms are v3 scene staging.

questions.title: Character typing
questions.text: Does the author confirm Lynleit's INFJ and Felix's ENFP working readings, and what further behavior settles Felix's judging function and Kyrien's ISTP versus INTJ uncertainty?

questions.title: Relationship
questions.text: At what point in the opening chapters does Lynleit reveal Kyrien's recruitment to Felix and Reiner, where does the disclosure occur, and how much time remains before Fionn's assassination?

questions.title: Boat operation
questions.text: Does the submerged blue flame leave a lasting injury on the Drowned Choir, and what does the girl's refusal to pursue Lynleit reveal about its limits?

questions.title: Character appearance
questions.text: What exact heights belong to the illustrated cast, and which artwork-derived hair, eye, build, or distinguishing details require correction?

questions.title: Covert alliance
questions.text: Beyond the confirmed river-surveillance operation, what does Lynleit refuse to provide Drake and Sherie, and what concessions or favors do they offer in return?

questions.title: Relationship
questions.text: Which later encounter results in the conception of Lynleit and Kyrien's son, what evidence makes the pregnancy inferable at the opening of Arc 2, and how much time separates Doom Has an Address, their later encounters, pregnancy, and disappearance?

holumns.title: There Is No Eleventh Floor
holumns.text: An office worker enters an elevator in a ten-floor building and encounters impossible floors, repeated rooms and luring voices. Lynleit brings him back; six minutes have elapsed on the office clock.
holumns.meta: HI-010 · Architectural entrapment and rescue testimony
holumns.detail: Physical continuity and repeated tests offer temporary guidance. Waiting rather than choosing another route precedes an elevator's appearance. Neither this escape nor the painted boundary is established as universally reliable, and the Holumn is not shown destroyed.

holumns.title: Bone Archive
holumns.text: The Bone Archive preserves experiences that have no place in the surviving account of a person's life. They return through memory and the body: an unexplained scar, a familiar pain, or a practiced movement its owner never learned. An officer steps aside before a shot is fired and later discovers a scar where the bullet would have entered.
holumns.meta: HI-008 · Bodily trace and discontinuous memory
holumns.detail: No countermeasure is known. The Archive cannot be relied on to undo events or predict the future. How its experiences are accessed, selected, repeated, or escaped is unknown.

holumns.title: Sleepers
holumns.text: Human figures hang roughly twenty to fifty metres above ground or water, heads lowered and limbs loose. Most of those Kyrien sees resemble men in trench coats and hats. Their faces are obscured by height and angle.
holumns.detail: No weakness or countermeasure is known. Kyrien does not attempt to harm them.

holumns.title: The Voice on the Line
holumns.text: The calls become incessant. The voice stops merely repeating the witness and begins speaking independently.

holumns.title: The Last Piece
holumns.text: A puzzle purchased at a market compels its owner to finish it. When the final piece is placed, the owner disappears and enters the missing-persons archive.
holumns.detail: No countermeasure is confirmed. Refusing completion appears safer than solving the object, but the strength and transfer of the compulsion remain unknown.

holumns.title: The Drowned Choir
holumns.text: A pale girl rises from the river with her eyes sewn shut by fishing line and a dress made from dead fish. She enslaves the souls of people drowned in the river and uses their hands to pull new victims beneath the surface.
holumns.detail: Lynleit's blue flame burns the submerged hands. Once the surface supports her, the hands beneath her cannot reach through it. This is an observed boundary around her escape, not a proven restriction across the entire river. No method of freeing the enslaved dead or defeating the girl is confirmed.

holumns.title: The River That Is Too Deep
holumns.text: Something immense moves beneath the city river despite stretches too shallow to contain it. Impossible waves damage boats and kayaks, while drowned bodies lose pieces to bites larger than any expected river predator could make.
holumns.detail: No countermeasure is confirmed. Its dependence on the river may be a boundary, but it is not yet known whether the water contains the Holumn or belongs to it.

holumns.title: The Nameless Street
holumns.text: A lost visitor may enter a deserted old street whose lanes, stairs, courtyards, and hills cannot be reconciled with the surrounding city. Following anyone encountered there may prevent the visitor from returning to ordinary streets.
holumns.meta: HI-005 · Urban legend and direct encounter
holumns.detail: The urban warning instructs visitors not to follow anyone encountered on the street. It is not known whether refusing the lure guarantees escape or why Lynleit returns after following it.

moments.title: There Is No Eleventh Floor
moments.text: Lynleit rescues an office worker from a building whose floors cannot be counted. His return brings seventeen days in Church custody, not an immediate return to ordinary life.
moments.detail: Early Arc 1, while Fionn is alive

moments.title: After the Rescue
moments.text: After Lynleit rescues the trapped office worker, Fionn questions the risks she took. Her appeal to Natalia's safety advice brings an unexpected answer.
moments.detail: Early Arc 1, after the office-building rescue

moments.title: University Days
moments.text: Before the Spill, Hiyu and Yulia study criminology together. His investigations keep giving her theories to question and evidence to check.
moments.detail: University years before the Spill; exact phase unplaced

moments.title: The Prosecutor's Return
moments.text: After Kyrien openly knows about Magi, a new offence by the Prosecutor General gives Lynleit a possible means of offering revenge. She requires proof; the original persecution remains institutionally protected.

moments.title: Only Eyes for You
moments.text: Felix and Reiner accompany Lynleit and Fionn on church visits. Reiner behaves; Felix keeps flirting with the nuns until Lynleit loses patience.
moments.detail: Before Fionn's death; exact phase unplaced

moments.title: Sleepers above the River
moments.text: On an early morning walk, Kyrien notices motionless human figures suspended above the river. He takes a boat downstream to see how far they extend.

moments.title: After the Failed Attempt
moments.text: Kyrien's legal campaign establishes credible evidence but cannot obtain accountability. After his failed attack at the Prosecutor General's dinner, Lynleit questions him with his lawyer present and offers confidential paid work.

moments.title: The Secret Third Ally
moments.text: Lynleit eventually tells only Felix and Reiner that she has recruited Kyrien as an unknown ally and possible trump card against Helena, keeping the decision hidden even from Fionn.

moments.title: Ash in the Family House
moments.text: Before the crisis reaches her home directly, Lynleit clumsily chases a grey male cat named Ash, catches him, then cannot bring herself to expel him into the rain.

moments.title: The First Missing Man
moments.text: The first man to disappear appears to be the Spill's first victim, but he independently causes the crisis. His identity and significance remain concealed for most of the story while hidden factions begin exploiting the catastrophe he created.

moments.title: The Warning Dismissed
moments.text: State Councillor Drake becomes convinced that a coup is developing somewhere inside Narvea, but neither his peers nor the Duke believe he has found more than disconnected irregularities.

moments.title: A Meeting Beyond Authority
moments.text: At night on a hill overlooking Vilen, Sherie leads an illegal negotiation in which Drake seeks limited access to MSF resources without surrendering sensitive evidence.

moments.title: The River Choir I: The Empty Boats Beneath the Bridge
moments.text: The River Choir, Part I. Kyrien checks the exits, endures four failed watches and boards the empty boats on the fifth. When the river takes hold of the team, the forbidden bank is the only ground he can reach.

moments.title: The River Choir II: The Water Beneath Her Feet
moments.text: The River Choir, Part II. Lynleit recounts the failure from the empty hold, the hands beneath the river, and her escape using an ability she has kept hidden.

moments.title: The River Choir III: The Wrong Bank
moments.text: The River Choir, Part III. Kyrien watches from the trees, withholds what he has seen and helps Lynleit find a way out of the quarantined park, where something moves above the path.

moments.title: The Last Man out of the Park
moments.text: A specially equipped paramilitary unit enters the sealed park and is massacred by forces it cannot understand. Captain Heyk becomes the sole survivor.

moments.title: Beyond the Cordon
moments.text: Hiyu enters the quarantined park to test his impossible suspicion that magic is involved in the disappearances. Yulia goes with him to prove the theory wrong and keep him alive.

moments.title: Shelter after the Accusation
moments.text: After exhausting her available resources to escape the directed hunt for her arrest, Lynleit reaches Kyrien's hotel-room hideout and finally loses the composure that carried her through the immediate crisis.

moments.title: The First Lines Back into MSF
moments.text: While Lynleit remains the target of an active arrest hunt, Kyrien helps her find secure ways to contact Felix and Reiner. Their reconnection becomes the first step in her slow campaign to reclaim MSF from Helena.

moments.title: Before the Arc Turns
moments.text: After surviving the shared curse in Doom Has an Address, Lynleit and Kyrien begin a sexual relationship and develop private jokes and ordinary habits before her pregnancy and disappearance near the Arc 2 threshold.

moments.title: The Nameless Street
moments.text: During a casual walk after lunch with Felix, Lynleit enters a deserted labyrinthine street, follows a crying girl with a red balloon, sees a dead boy below a broken fence, and is pushed from the same ledge before waking on an ordinary city bench.

moments.title: Father Mikhail Discovers the Breach
moments.text: Father Mikhail becomes the first authority to discover that Lynleit has shared forbidden knowledge of magic with outsiders. Kyrien corrects her attempt to limit the breach to himself by revealing that Felix and Reiner also know.

moments.title: The Coat Fionn Left Behind
moments.text: Midway through Arc 1, after losing a blue suede jacket in the river and after Fionn's death, Lynleit learns that he had discreetly replaced the blue coat she wears with a garment sewn from material called the hide of leviathan.

moments.title: Because There's a Battle to Be Fought
moments.text: Lynleit asks Kyrien why he continues to help her and risk his life when no reward awaits him. He answers immediately: "Because there's a battle to be fought."

moments.title: Terrors Inside the Academy
moments.text: While Lynleit is dispatched to Cardiff, she answers Natalia's request by sending Kyrien into the Magi Academy as Myka's undercover helper. The danger exceeds Lynleit's estimate and forces Natalia to intervene personally.

moments.title: Father Mikhail's Foreign Venture
moments.text: Father Mikhail travels to Cardiff on special-envoy duty and is drawn into a life-and-death operation against several Magi threats. Lynleit is later sent abroad to assist him, without MSF or its conventional arsenal.

moments.title: Myka Enters MSF
moments.text: After surviving the Academy crisis and graduating at the top of her class, Myka is recruited by MSF as a strong Magus.

moments.title: The Unresolved Assassination
moments.text: Fionn is found dead below the hill at the Vilen family house after several incompatible agendas converge without one actor controlling the whole outcome. Helena knowingly opens one part of the path, then uses his death and Lynleit's stunned response to seize MSF and frame her.

moments.title: Households before the Spill
moments.text: A prequel outline follows Fionn and the development of MSF alongside the younger cast's school years.

moments.title: Unresolved Tension
moments.text: Felix complains about Lynleit during a card game. From the red sofa, Sherie offers an observation he would rather dispute.
moments.detail: Early Sherie and Felix familiarity; exact phase unplaced
